context: Riku-teen helps Sho fix a broken bicycle in the garage.
purpose: Teen-to-teen practical help; shared repair time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 自転車、チェーン外れた!
lines.en: The chain came off my bike!
lines.style: Quick, surprised catch in the throat on the opening. Urgent but not panicked — the worry of someone young who doesn't want to seem helpless. Slightly breathless, eyes wider than usual.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: For real? I'll get some tools.
lines.style: Straightforward, no hesitation. Soft tone — not making a big deal of it, just solving. The quiet competence of someone who likes being useful. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Genuine relief in the exhale. Soft and sincere. No performance, no extra emotion — just the lightness of someone who was worried and now isn't. Brief.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Quiet assessment, like thinking aloud. Even tone, slightly lower register. Small note of reassurance underneath — he's already mentally fixing it. Not looking at Sho as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, careful question. A hint of lingering worry underneath the hope — checking in, not demanding certainty. Slight uplift on the question mark. Searching his face.
